tagline: Find out your exact age in years, months, and days from your date of birth, plus how many days until your next birthday.
title: Age Calculator - How Old Am I? Calculate Age by Date of Birth
description: Free age calculator: enter your date of birth and get your exact age in years, months, and days, and see how many days until your next birthday. Works as of any date.
keywords: age calculator by date of birth
howTo: Optionally set an 'as of' date (defaults to today).
Click Calculate to see your exact age and days until your next birthday.

faq.q: How does the age calculator work?
faq.a: It compares your date of birth with the 'as of' date and computes the exact number of years, months, and days between them, counting leap years correctly.

faq.q: How old will I be on a specific date?
faq.a: Use the optional 'Age as of' field: pick any future or past date and the calculator will compute your age at exactly that date.

faq.q: How many days until my next birthday?
faq.a: The calculator shows the date of your next birthday and the number of days remaining, based on the current date.
Yes. All calculations happen locally in your browser. Your date of birth is never sent to any server or stored anywhere.

faq.q: Can I calculate someone else's age?
faq.a: Yes, simply enter another person's date of birth in the calculator.
